Subject: Pipeline flightslot orchestration + sizing ask for BrightWave close window

Team —

Quick context: BrightWave (Emily Chang) just moved their pilot into a firm close window for the week of June 14. They expect a steady ramp during the pilot and are asking for an initial committed pool + burst slots for inference-heavy evaluation. HubSpot shows a likely close (HS-34912) if we can commit slot safety for the pilot. I attached the quarter forecast from the AE.

Ask: can infra confirm a recommended reserved-sizing + burst plan we can offer in the SOW by EOD Friday (May 28)? Specific questions we need to answer for the sales/finance thread: 
- Minimum reserved GPUs (vCPU/GPU type suggestion) for baseline throughput (see forecast)
- Burst eligibility and expected latency hit if burst is used simultaneously by other pilots
- Suggested commit window and penalties/credits language to tie into sales pricing

Notes: BrightWave is US-based, pilot expected to start ~2027-06-14, estimated steady token TPS in the forecast sheet. I'm asking finance to hold a provisional bill-of-materials so we can show cost ranges.

Attachments: BrightWave_pipeline_forecast.xlsx (forecast + sample usage profile)

Next steps: 
- Ben / Marcus: can you do an initial feasibility + rough sizing?
- Laura: if infra can provide a sizing matrix, I can fold that into a one-pager for Emily and procurement.
- Karthik: any redlines on the commit/SLAs we should flag now?

Thanks — Iris

--
Irene Choi

Subject: Re: Pipeline flightslot orchestration + sizing ask for BrightWave close window

Irene —

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick read on the attached: baseline TPS suggests a modest reserved pool but the burst tail could get spiky (1.5-2x baseline) for short windows. Two quick items from infra side: 

1) GPU type: Assuming we keep to our standard a2-highmem equivalents (or their upstream analog), the economics and latency look acceptable. If BrightWave insists on lower latency at higher QPS we should propose a mixed pool (reserved for baseline on A100-style and burst on T4-style cheaper instances) — I'll diagram this.

2) Burst eligibility: current policy allows burst for pilot accounts up to 40% of idle capacity within the region. If multiple pilots go live we risk throttling, which could show as increased tail latency. We can provide a soft SLA for pilot (best-effort burst) but recommend a small committed buffer if they want guaranteed tail.

I can sketch a proposed sizing matrix by tomorrow (Wednesday) EOD. Marcus — can you confirm regional capacity (us-west) for the week of 6/14 and whether we have planned maintenance windows?

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Principal Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi team —

I've pulled together a first-pass sizing matrix and uploaded it to the shared drive (link below). Summary:

- Recommended reserved starting point: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs for baseline throughput. Expected sustained latency <70ms p95 for the profile in the forecast.
- Recommended burst pool: additional 6 x T4-equivalent (or fractional quantized slots) for short-duration spikes. Burst behaves best if we can throttle across accounts to 60% of peak; otherwise p95 will slip ~30-40ms.
- Commit ask: 3-month minimum term for reserved with option to scale up after pilot based on observed token burn. If sales wants firm tail SLAs we need at least a 6-month reserved commitment.

I've attached the CSV export (proposed_sizing_matrix.csv) and added inline comments in Drive. Proposed next steps:
1) Infrastructure: confirm availability & maintenance blackout for the week of 6/14 (Marcus).
2) Finance/Sales: tee up a provisional cost range based on the 3-month vs 6-month commit (Irene/Ben).
3) Legal/Procurement: prep a procurement checklist and timeline — we should have a redline SOW ready by 6/4 if BrightWave signs the preliminary MOU this week.

Link: https://drive.redwood/workspace/brightwave/pipeline-forecast-2027 (drive, sizing matrix uploaded)

Laura

--

Karthik note to procurement (Mark): we need a provisional SOW draft and pricing worksheet that includes both:

Timeline: procurement draft needed by EOD Wed 6/2 to hit legal redline queue and return to sales by Friday 6/4. BrightWave is prioritizing a decision week of 6/7.
